
DESCRIPTION
Switch the environment-variable source

USAGE
  one env switch <backend> [flags]

TIPS
Switches between the local dotenv source and Infisical. Local values can be synchronized when switching to Infisical; switching back never deletes remote data.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Print the plan without writing
  --global                 管理 Infisical 全局变量，可在工作区之外使用
  --no-sync                Switch the source without synchronizing values
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --overwrite              Overwrite conflicting values in the destination
  --path <value>           全局变量目录（仅当前层，不递归）
  -y, --yes                Confirm synchronization non-interactively
